title: 开放模型发展现状：2026年夏季观察
summary: 本文是Hugging Face于2026年夏季发布的关于开放模型（Open Models）发展现状的观察报告。报告指出，开放模型在性能上已接近甚至部分超越闭源模型，特别是在推理、代码生成和多模态任务上。开源社区生态持续繁荣，模型数量和质量显著提升，但同时也面临算力成本、数据版权和监管合规等挑战。文章分析了主流开放模型（如Llama、Mistral、DeepSeek等）的最新进展，并讨论了开放权重与真正开源（如数据、训练代码）之间的区别。此外，报告还探讨了开放模型在商业化应用中的优势与风险，以及未来可能的发展方向，包括高效微调、模型压缩和联邦学习等技术的融合。总体而言，开放模型正成为AI领域的重要力量，但需在开放性、安全性和可持续性之间寻求平衡。
summary_en: This article is an observation report on the state of open models in summer 2026, published by Hugging Face. It notes that open models have approached or even surpassed closed-source models in performance, especially in reasoning, code generation, and multimodal tasks. The open-source community ecosystem continues to thrive, with significant increases in model quantity and quality, but challenges remain in compute costs, data copyright, and regulatory compliance. The report analyzes the latest progress of mainstream open models (e.g., Llama, Mistral, DeepSeek) and discusses the distinction between open weights and truly open source (including data and training code). It also explores the advantages and risks of open models in commercial applications, as well as future directions such as efficient fine-tuning, model compression, and federated learning. Overall, open models are becoming a major force in AI, but a balance between openness, safety, and sustainability is needed.
